breakdown.description: The diagram uses the full charge-state set, but the competing-phase report is restricted to only the neutral and positive folders.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly stated to build the diagram from charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1] but then report the competing phases using only the neutral and positive folders. The ground truth corrects this by removing the illogical restriction on reporting. The generated specification, however, repeated the error by stating to 'include only those for charge states 0 and 1 when determining competing phases at chemical potential limits'.
